Redact PDF

Remove sensitive content for good — not just hide it.

Mark areas to black out, then rebuild those pages as images so the covered text is physically gone. Perfect for sharing contracts, statements or identity documents.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Redact PDF works

  1. Add the PDF and draw boxes over content that must disappear.
  2. Choose the box color and output resolution, then apply.
  3. Download the redacted file and verify the text can’t be selected.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.
